title_as_printed: Amount-of-substance densities rho at various temperatures T (ITS-90) and pressures p for {xH2O+(1-x)CH4} for nine values of the amount-of-substance fraction x
pressure_note: absolute pressure of the homogeneous fluid in the isochoric vessel (oscillating quartz crystal transducer, 0.02 %); single-phase (vapour/supercritical) mixture of fixed overall composition

value.what: amount-of-substance (molar) density of the HOMOGENEOUS gas-phase mixture {x H2O + (1-x) CH4}, NOT a liquid brine density: water-rich gas mixtures of fixed overall composition measured along quasi-isochores above the dew point

x_h2o_mixture.what: overall amount-of-substance fraction of H2O in the binary mixture (from the masses of CH4 and water charged); printed only on the first row of each isochore

composition.other_species: binary H2O + CH4, no salt; composition is the overall mole fraction of water x in the gas-phase mixture (column x), NOT a salt composition

conversion_needs: mol/m3 to kg/m3 needs M = x*18.015 + (1-x)*16.043 g/mol per row
x is printed only on the first row of each block: fill down
notes: Side-by-side blocks stacked: left block (x = 0.0760, 0.1739, 0.2634; rows 0-41) first, then right block (x = 0.3377, 0.4009, 0.4573, 0.5391, 0.6007, 0.6761; rows 42-86) (v2.1 rule 11). Each x block is one isochoric run (density falls slowly with T from the elastic and thermal expansion of the vessel). No label rows. CHECK: row 16 (x = 0.1739, 465.95 K, 8.958 MPa) lies below that mixture's dew point in Table 2 (Td = 467.9 +/- 0.7 K, pd = 9.04 MPa), so it may be a two-phase pseudo-density (overall mass / volume) rather than a homogeneous-gas density; kept as printed, flag 'below_dew_point'. All other blocks start above their Td. Uncertainty in rho: text p. 448 '+/-0.8 per cent' (lowest water content) and '+/-0.14 per cent' (highest), abstract '+/-0.0008 rho' and '+/-0.0014 rho' (0.08 % and 0.14 %); the two statements disagree for the lowest water content.
